analyst.summary: Jayaswal Neco Industries makes iron and steel castings and pig iron, and just posted a very strong quarter -- profit more than doubled -- after a weak multi-year growth trend, at a statistically cheap valuation. That cheapness needs to be read alongside two real facts: leverage is higher than most peers in this review (thin interest cushion), and the company has an unresolved Enforcement Directorate matter with roughly Rs 308 crore of its properties provisionally attached, currently on appeal at the Supreme Court after a lower court had cleared the company. We rate it a Hold but are flagging the legal matter for portfolio-manager review given how directly it could affect the balance sheet.
